scenarios.title: A｜询问信件内容
scenarios.setting: 玩家收到一封政府部门寄来的信，但没有完全看懂内容，于是带着信去咨询。

turns.text: Hi. I received this letter, but I’m not sure what it means.

turns.prompt: 你想请工作人员解释信件要求自己做什么，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you explain what this letter is asking me to do?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain what this letter is asking me to do?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’m having trouble understanding this part.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m having trouble understanding this part.
feedback.explanation: 说明正在尝试的动作或遇到的困难，帮助对方针对卡住的环节提供协助。

choices.text: Does this mean there’s a problem with my application?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this mean there’s a problem with my application?
feedback.explanation: “application”指申请或申请材料，办理时可据此查询进度。

choices.text: Could you tell me what this section means?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me what this section means?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I don’t understand what this letter wants from me.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain what this letter is asking me to do?
feedback.explanation: 这句口语中可以表达看不懂信件要求；正式咨询可直接问“What do I need to do?”。

turns.text: It says we need some additional information before we can continue processing your application.

turns.prompt: 你想确认需要补交哪些信息或材料，会怎么说？

choices.text: What additional information do you need?

feedback.naturalExpression: What additional information do you need?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Which documents do I need to provide?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which documents do I need to provide?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Does the letter say when I need to submit them by?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does the letter say when I need to submit them by?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Does this mean my application has been rejected?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this mean my application has been rejected?
feedback.explanation: “application”指申请或申请材料，办理时可据此查询进度。

turns.text: No. It hasn’t been rejected. We just need one more document.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, that’s good to know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, that’s good to know.
feedback.explanation: “good to know”表示这条信息有用，是接收建议或说明后的简短回应。

choices.text: I see. Which document am I missing?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. Which document am I missing?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

scenarios.title: B｜不知道下一步怎么办
scenarios.setting: 在“收到官方信件”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“不知道下一步怎么办”。

turns.text: I received this notice yesterday, but I’m not sure what I’m supposed to do next.
Have you read the instructions on the second page?

turns.prompt: 关于「收到官方信件」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Yes, but I’m still not sure what action I need to take.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but I’m still not sure what action I need to take.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Do I need to respond to this letter?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to respond to this letter?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Do I need to come here in person?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to come here in person?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Can I deal with this online?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I deal with this online?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: What should I do after receiving this?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but I’m still not sure what action I need to take.
feedback.explanation: 这句能问下一步，但“this”指代依赖上下文；指出是哪封信或哪份材料，会更便于答复。

turns.text: You need to complete this form and return it within 30 days.

turns.prompt: 你想确认填好的表格该提交到哪里、能否线上提交，会怎么说？

choices.text: Where do I send the completed form?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where do I send the completed form?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的信息限定为地点或位置，适合请人指路或定位物品。

choices.text: Can I submit it online instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I submit it online instead?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Do I need to include any supporting documents?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to include any supporting documents?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: What happens if I miss the deadline?

feedback.naturalExpression: What happens if I miss the deadline?
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

turns.text: You can either mail it to the address on the letter or submit it online.

turns.prompt: 关于「收到官方信件」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll submit it online.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll submit it online.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. Do I need to keep a copy for my records?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Do I need to keep a copy for my records?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Will I receive confirmation once you’ve received it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I receive confirmation once you’ve received it?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

scenarios.title: C｜联系相关部门
scenarios.setting: 信件上要求玩家联系某个部门，但玩家不知道具体应该找谁。

turns.text: Hi. I’m calling about a letter I received from your department.
Do you have the letter with you?

turns.prompt: 关于「收到官方信件」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Yes. It says I need to contact your office.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It says I need to contact your office.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Yes. There’s a reference number on the letter.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. There’s a reference number on the letter.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: Yes. I’m calling because I need some clarification about the notice.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I’m calling because I need some clarification about the notice.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I received a letter asking me to contact this department.

feedback.naturalExpression: I received a letter asking me to contact this department.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: Your department sent me a paper and told me to call.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It says I need to contact your office.
feedback.explanation: 正式通知用“letter / notice”比“paper”具体；也可报出信件上的部门或参考编号。

turns.text: Could you give me the reference number?

turns.prompt: 你想提供办理记录的查询编号，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. It’s R-583204.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s R-583204.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes. Let me read it out to you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Let me read it out to you.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Is that the number in the top right corner?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is that the number in the top right corner?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: Yes. I can see your case here. What would you like to know?

turns.prompt: 关于「收到官方信件」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to know why I received this notice.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to know why I received this notice.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could you tell me what I need to do next?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me what I need to do next?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to submit?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to submit?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Is there a deadline I need to be aware of?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a deadline I need to be aware of?
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: Could you connect me with the person handling my case?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you connect me with the person handling my case?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: I’ll transfer you to the department handling your case.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Thanks. I appreciate your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I appreciate your help.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
